pick.name: Kokoro-82M (kokoro-onnx)
pick.what: 82M Apache-licensed open-weight TTS; ONNX runner for CPU
pick.why: Natural voice on CPU, small; en US/UK, Hindi, es, fr, it, pt, ja, zh

alts.name: Piper (piper1-gpl)
alts.license: GPL-3.0 copyleft - avoid in proprietary/open-core products
alts.platforms: unclear (Windows support not stated on page)

alts.name: Gemini API TTS (free tier)
alts.what: Hosted speech models, several marked free
alts.why: Most natural and multilingual (Indian-language support unverified)
alts.free_limits: Free tier trains on data; limits unpublished

candidates.name: edge-tts
candidates.verdict: Unofficial Microsoft endpoint, ToS risk (not verified)

decision: Kokoro locally for Apache-licensed CPU TTS; Gemini TTS when broad multilingual naturalness matters (free tier is not for EEA/UK end users). Avoid Piper in shipped products because of GPL-3.0.

region_notes.India: Indian-language quality of Gemini TTS and Kokoro is unverified; test before committing.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
